article.title: A Weekend Without a Phone
article.content:
Maya often checked her phone while spending time with her younger brother. One Friday, he said that she never heard his stories. Maya decided to leave her phone in a drawer for part of the weekend. She did not switch it off for two whole days; she checked important messages for ten minutes each evening.

On Saturday, they built a small birdhouse from an old wooden box. They followed instructions in a library book and asked their mother to help with the sharp tools. On Sunday, they put the birdhouse in the garden. No birds came that day, but her brother was excited to wait. Maya realised that paying attention to one person could be more interesting than checking many messages.
article.translation:
玛雅和弟弟相处时经常看手机。一个周五，弟弟说她从来没有听他的故事。玛雅决定在周末的部分时间把手机放在抽屉里。她并没有整整两天关机，而是每晚用十分钟查看重要消息。

周六，他们用一个旧木盒做了小鸟屋。他们参考图书馆借来的书中的步骤，使用锋利工具时请妈妈帮忙。周日，他们把鸟屋放进花园。那天没有鸟来，但弟弟兴奋地等着。玛雅发现，专心陪伴一个人可能比查看许多消息更有趣。

questions.prompt: What made Maya change her phone habit?
options: Her brother said she did not listen
questions.explanation: 第一段弟弟说她没有听自己的故事，促使她作出改变。

questions.prompt: How did Maya use her phone that weekend?
options: She kept it off all weekend
She checked it every ten minutes
She only used it to take photos
She checked important messages each evening
questions.explanation: 她每晚用十分钟查看重要消息，并非整整两天关机。

questions.prompt: Which statement is true about the birdhouse?
options: They bought it from a shop
They used a library book for instructions
The children used sharp tools alone
questions.explanation: 他们参考了图书馆借书中的步骤；用旧木盒制作，使用锋利工具时有妈妈帮助，当天也没有鸟来。
